dep-spec.description: Replacement dependency: version string or dependency table. Cargo validates source conflicts and resolves the replacement crate.

version.description:
Semver requirement matched against the patched package.
https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/specifying-dependencies.html

path.description:
Filesystem path to the replacement crate. Relative paths resolve relative to the config file containing this `[patch]` section.
https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/config.html#patch

git.description:
Git repository URL providing the replacement crate.
https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/specifying-dependencies.html#specifying-dependencies-from-git-repositories

branch.description: Git branch to use. Mutually exclusive with `tag` and `rev`.

tag.description: Git tag to use. Mutually exclusive with `branch` and `rev`.

rev.description: Git revision (commit-ish) to use. Mutually exclusive with `branch` and `tag`.

package.description:
Real package name when the patch entry's key is a rename. Lets you patch a crate while referring to it under a different name in your manifest.
https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/specifying-dependencies.html#renaming-dependencies-in-cargotoml

registry.description: Name of the registry the replacement is fetched from when using `version`. Refers to a key under `[registries]`.

default-features.description: Parsed but ignored for patch selection; configure features on the dependency that uses this patch.

features.description: Parsed but ignored for patch selection; configure features on the dependency that uses this patch.

optional.description: Whether the dependency is optional. Rarely meaningful inside `[patch]`; included for parity with the dependency-table format.

public.description: Whether the dependency is part of the public API (unstable nightly feature).

registry-index.description: Internal registry index URL used by Cargo when publishing.

base.description: UNSTABLE: Named path base; requires path-bases support.

lib.description: UNSTABLE: Also use the artifact dependency as a library; requires -Z bindeps.

target.description: UNSTABLE: Artifact target platform; requires -Z bindeps.

title: [patch]
description:
Dependency patch overrides. Outer key is the registry name being patched (typically `crates-io`, or a name from `[registries]`); inner key is the package name being replaced; innermost table is the replacement dependency specification, using the same format as Cargo.toml `[patch]`.
https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/config.html#patch

additionalProperties.description:
Patches keyed by registry name. The conventional key is `crates-io`; user-defined registry names from `[registries]` are also valid.
https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/overriding-dependencies.html#the-patch-section
